Storm-3358 mainly targets financial organizations in Southeast Asia and a smaller number globally. The report says ARTEX agents combine with conventional tools to scan internet-facing systems, exploit flaws such as anonymous file upload and SSRF, and install open-source RATs (WISP, vshell, AdaptixC2) for persistence and lateral movement. 85e7115b84fbebc7115a99a358fb269724ecc922.summary: Wikipedia-style article on PLA Unit 61398, a People's Liberation Army cyber unit said to be based in Pudong, Shanghai, and alleged to be a source of Chinese computer hacking. The unit is also known as APT1 and Comment Crew. The US Department of Justice announced an indictment of five officers in May 2014. Mandiant attributed APT1 activity to the unit. FireEye estimated the group had attacked more than 1,000 organisations. China denied involvement until 2013, when it admitted to having cyber warfare units.
